metadata.description: Rules, skills, agents, and hooks for agentic development of web apps, static sites, Unreal Engine plugins, and Android apps with Claude Code.

plugins.name: rfr-core
plugins.description: Core skills, agents, and hooks for every project, including a skill that installs rules-for-robots rule packs into a repo. Add rfr-web or rfr-unreal for your domain.

plugins.name: rfr-web
plugins.description: For websites and web apps: the web-engineer agent, accessibility and performance audits, and guards for Vercel (MCP and CLI) and database commands. Requires rfr-core.

plugins.name: rfr-unreal
plugins.description: For Unreal Engine plugins: the unreal-engineer agent, Fab packaging, Unreal Insights profiling, and an editor -ExecCmds check. Requires rfr-core.

plugins.name: rfr-android
plugins.description: For Android, Android TV, and Google TV apps: a device guard that asks only before an adb command changes a shared device. Requires rfr-core.

plugins.name: rfr-process
plugins.description: A staged project development process: artifact templates, links between artifacts, and a CI check for stale or broken links. Depends on rfr-core.

plugins.name: rfr-feedback
plugins.description: Optional: report findings to the rules-for-robots repository as feedback issues, checked for private details and filed only when you confirm. No other plugin depends on it.
